description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that initializes a user interface, manages a log display fragment, and sets up logging mechanisms. It includes methods for creating the activity, handling menu options, and configuring logging chains.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI components, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds a fragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title of the log toggle item.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
